Samsung TV & Appliance products, Samsung-owned open source projects listed on https://github.com/Samsung/, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Samsung that are not in another CNA’s scope. This includes Claude Code, Claude Desktop, browser extensions, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) SDKs and reference servers, Anthropic API client SDKs, and related developer tooling published under the Anthropic, anthropic-experimental, and modelcontextprotocol GitHub organizations.
